features: Fix pre-existing TypeScript errors in test files (missing noDocs and documenter properties on HarnessConfig in tests/)
Remove unused imports and dead code across all Phase 1 Deepen files
Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions in shared/ modules added or modified during Phase 1 Deepen
Final test coverage gap closure: ensure every shared/ module has at least one corresponding test file

criteria.name: typescript_zero_errors_including_tests
criteria.description: Running `bunx tsc --noEmit` produces zero type errors across the entire project including shared/, claude-harness/, AND tests/ directories. The 8 pre-existing errors in tests/ (missing noDocs and documenter properties on HarnessConfig) identified in sprint 5 feedback are fixed. Verified by running the command and confirming exit code 0 with no error output.

criteria.name: no_unused_imports_in_phase1_files
criteria.description: All files in shared/ and claude-harness/ that were added or modified during Phase 1 Deepen (sprints 1-6) have zero unused imports. Specifically, the unused truncateStaticAnalysisOutput import in cross-feature-integration.test.ts identified in sprint 5 feedback is removed. Verified by running `bunx biome check shared/ claude-harness/` or manual review confirming no unused import warnings.

criteria.name: jsdoc_on_exported_functions_in_shared
criteria.description: Every exported function in shared/regression.ts, shared/diff.ts, shared/static-analysis.ts, shared/refinement.ts, and shared/config.ts has a JSDoc comment with at least a one-line @description and @param tags for each parameter. Verified by reading each file and confirming JSDoc blocks exist above every `export function` or `export async function` declaration.

criteria.name: all_shared_modules_have_test_files
criteria.description: Every .ts module in shared/ (excluding .test.ts files and type-only files like types.ts) has a corresponding .test.ts file in shared/. Specifically, shared/diff.ts, shared/regression.ts, shared/static-analysis.ts, shared/refinement.ts, shared/config.ts, shared/files.ts, shared/skills.ts, shared/logger.ts, shared/usage.ts, shared/interaction.ts, shared/conversation-logger.ts, shared/doc-validation.ts, and shared/artifact-digest.ts each have a shared/<name>.test.ts file that exists and contains at least one test case. Verified by globbing shared/*.ts and shared/*.test.ts and confirming coverage.

criteria.name: all_existing_tests_pass
criteria.description: Running `bun test shared/` produces zero failures. All tests from sprints 1-5 plus any new tests added in sprint 6 pass. Exit code 0 from the test runner. The total test count is >= 124 (the count from sprint 5).

criteria.name: biome_lint_clean
criteria.description: Running `bunx biome check shared/ claude-harness/` (or the project's configured lint command) produces zero errors and zero warnings on all files in shared/ and claude-harness/. If biome.json has rules disabled, those are excluded, but no new rule suppressions (biome-ignore comments) are added in sprint 6.

criteria.name: no_any_casts_in_phase1_code
criteria.description: No `as any`, `: any`, or `<any>` type casts exist in any Phase 1 Deepen files: shared/regression.ts, shared/diff.ts, shared/static-analysis.ts, shared/refinement.ts, shared/artifact-digest.ts, and their corresponding test files. Verified by grep or code review.

criteria.name: no_dead_code_or_unreachable_branches
criteria.description: No unreachable code (code after unconditional return/throw), no unused local variables, and no commented-out code blocks (>3 lines) exist in shared/ or claude-harness/ files modified during Phase 1 Deepen. Verified by code review or static analysis.

criteria.name: consistent_error_handling_pattern
criteria.description: All JSON.parse call sites in shared/ (regression.ts, files.ts, config.ts) are wrapped in try-catch blocks that either (a) log a descriptive warning and return a safe default, or (b) throw a descriptive error mentioning the file path and parse failure reason. No bare JSON.parse calls without error handling exist. Verified by searching for JSON.parse in shared/ and confirming each is guarded.

criteria.name: no_regressions_in_sprint5_criteria
criteria.description: All 15 criteria from the sprint 5 contract still hold: sprint selection + regression injection works, combined flags don't crash, refinement preserves regression criteria, diff and static analysis coexist, CLI flags are documented, invalid inputs are handled gracefully, and malformed regression.json is handled. Verified by running `bun test shared/` which includes the cross-feature-integration.test.ts from sprint 5.
